# Ubuntu's prebuilt Qt libraries are not instrumented with ThreadSanitizer.
# Limit suppressions to Qt internals that cross that boundary; races wholly
# inside OpenSCP remain reportable.
race:qFormatLogMessage
race:QtPrivate::QFunctorSlotObject
race:QMetaObject::invokeMethodImpl
race:QThreadPoolPrivate::enqueueTask
race:QArrayData::reallocateUnaligned
